The project builds successfully. Here's what was created:

**Project:** `RecipeCommunity` (Blazor Web App with Server interactivity)

**Structure:**
- `Models/Recipe.cs` — Recipe data model
- `Services/RecipeService.cs` — In-memory recipe store with seed data
- `Components/Pages/Home.razor` — Homepage with 6 category cards (static SSR)
- `Components/Pages/Category.razor` — Lists recipes in a category (static SSR)
- `Components/Pages/RecipeDetail.razor` — Full recipe view with rating widget (static SSR)
- `Components/Pages/SubmitRecipe.razor` — Interactive form (`@rendermode InteractiveServer`)
- `Components/Shared/StarRating.razor` — Click-to-rate 1–5 stars (`@rendermode InteractiveServer`)

**Key design decisions:**
- Most pages render as static SSR (no WebSocket overhead)
- Only the star-rating widget and submit form use `InteractiveServer` — the two components that need user interaction
- `RecipeService` is registered as a singleton for shared state
- Nav menu links to categories and submit page

Run with `dotnet run` from the `RecipeCommunity/` directory.
